instruction.text: Choose the definition which describes what you see in the picture.

atoms.b: Parallel lines are lines that can never cross each other.
Intersecting lines are any lines that cross each other. All perpendicular lines are intersecting lines but not all intersecting lines are perpendicular.
Perpendicular lines are lines that cross each other at right angles.

hint.text: All perpendicular lines are intersecting lines but not all intersecting lines are perpendicular.
